description: Hochwasserschutz Frankfurt (Oder) - (Daten-HOCHWASSERSCHUTZ) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by frankfurt-oder.de. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
